name: matchcut-reel
description: A real-product reel: recorded takes under a virtual camera, captions, an end card, its own score.

scripts.preview: remotion render src/index.ts Reel out/reel.mp4 --crf=16 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/reel.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 22 -preset slow -c:a aac -b:a 160k -map_metadata -1 -movflags +faststart out/reel-720.mp4
